name: oauth-resource-server
description: JWT bearer authentication through operator-managed HAProxy.
prerequisites: Installed operator watching generated namespaces; served MarkLogic CRD.
Delete-reclaim storage class, capacity for a two-node TLS MarkLogic cluster, and pull access to fixture images.
See marklogic-server/oauth/README.md for HAProxy requirements and coverage.

name: oauth-authorization-code
description: MLE-17734 Authorization Code flow with test-owned HAProxy backend observations and controlled no-affinity routing.
prerequisites: Installed operator watching generated namespaces; served MarkLogic CRD.
Delete-reclaim storage class, capacity for a two-node TLS MarkLogic cluster, and pull access to fixture images.
MARKLOGIC_VERSION is a caller declaration; it must match the image. See marklogic-server/oauth/README.md.

name: haproxy-session-affinity
description: HAProxy SessionID affinity contract against nginx backends.
prerequisites: Pull access and capacity for nginx, HAProxy, and curl fixtures.
No MarkLogic image, operator, or storage class required.

name: backup-s3
description: Secret-backed AWS credentials followed by full S3 backup, data mutation, and restore verification (EKS/static credentials validated; see scenario README).
prerequisites: Installed operator and CRD supporting spec.objectStorage; generated namespaces must be watched.
Existing AWS S3 bucket and a dedicated test prefix, reachable from MarkLogic; cloud credentials need list/read/write access. AWS_SESSION_TOKEN is optional and must remain valid for the whole run.
Two-node TLS MarkLogic fixture with Delete-reclaim persistent storage; curl image pull access.
S3 backup objects are retained as evidence under a unique run prefix; namespace cleanup does not delete them. See marklogic-server/backup/README.md for scope, retention, and cleanup.

name: platform-smoke
description: Teaching example: ConfigMap mount and isolated Kubernetes lifecycle; not a PDC test.
prerequisites: Pull access to busybox:1.37.0 and capacity for one small Pod.
Shared Kubernetes preflight permissions, including pod exec and namespace lifecycle; see marklogic-server/platform/README.md.
No operator, MarkLogic, persistent storage, or OAuth setup. Local contracts only; live validation pending.
